content:
{'original': "According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple has some new features in the works for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 that are set to appeal more to health-conscious users. The company is also reportedly testing two finishes for a rumored ceramic version.", 'translation': '根據彭博記者 Mark Gurman 透露，Apple 為 Apple Watch Series 12 和 Ultra 4 準備咗幾項新功能，將會令注重健康嘅用家更感興趣。據悉公司仲喺度測試傳聞中陶瓷版本嘅兩種飾面。'}

{'original': 'New health upgrades', 'translation': '新健康功能升級'}

{'original': "If you've been underwhelmed by the Apple Watch's performance as a fitness tracker, these two main health upgrades should appeal to you. They are: all-day heart rate tracking, and a brand-new app interface that makes it easier to glean useful information from your health data. Here is Gurman's description of the new app:", 'translation': '如果你對 Apple Watch 作為健身追蹤器嘅表現未感滿意，以下呢兩項主要健康功能升級應該會令你覺得吸引。兩項新功能分別係：全天候心率追蹤，以及全新設計嘅應用程式介面，令你更容易從健康數據中獲得有用資訊。以下係 Gurman 對新應用程式嘅描述：'}

{'original': "As a current WHOOP user, I'll say that the main reason it appeals to me is that the WHOOP app makes it easier to glean useful information from health data. It shows me all the factors contributing to my poor sleep or recovery, but with the Apple Watch, it feels like the only thing that matters is your activity rings. If Apple makes meaningful progress here, I'll be quite happy.", 'translation': '作為現時 WHOOP 嘅用家，我要講一句，吸引我用佢嘅主要原因一直係 WHOOP 應用程式令我更容易從健康數據中獲得有用資訊。佢會顯示出所有導致我睡眠或恢復質素差嘅因素，但用 Apple Watch 嘅時候，感覺上唯一重要嘅嘢就係你嘅活動紀錄圈。如果 Apple 喺呢方面取得有意義嘅進步，我會相當高興。'}

{'original': "One key to making the Apple Watch's data experience richer is simply having more data. Apple is reportedly testing the ability for the heart rate sensor to record continuously throughout the day, rather than just during workouts or at random times.", 'translation': '要令 Apple Watch 嘅數據體驗更加豐富，關鍵之一係要有更多數據。據報 Apple 正在測試讓心率感測器能夠全日持續記錄，而唔係只喺做運動期間或者隨機時間先記錄。'}

{'original': 'Two new finishes', 'translation': '兩種新飾面'}

{'original': 'We\'ve heard before that Apple is considering ceramic for the Apple Watch Series 12, and Gurman now reports there will be two colors: traditional white, as well as dark gray. There will also be "several new band colors and combinations" at launch.', 'translation': '我哋之前已經聽講 Apple 正考慮為 Apple Watch Series 12 採用陶瓷材質，而 Gurman 而家就報導指將會有兩種顏色選擇：傳統白色，以及深灰色。屆時仲會有「多款新嘅錶帶顏色同配搭」。'}

{'original': 'A redesign in the future', 'translation': '未來嘅重新設計'}

{'original': "Apple's current Watch design language was introduced in 2024 with the Apple Watch Series 10. It was a relatively mild change, with the company making the watch thinner at the expense of slightly larger bezels. According to Bloomberg, we may see a fresh Apple Watch design with the Series 11 next year, though it could be pushed back to the Series 12:", 'translation': '現時 Apple Watch 嘅設計風格係喺 2024 年由 Apple Watch Series 10 開始採用嘅。當時屬於一次相對溫和嘅改動，公司以略為加大嘅邊框作為取捨，將手錶做得更薄。據彭博報導，我哋可能會喺明年見到 Series 11 嘅全新 Apple Watch 設計，不過亦有可能會延後到 Series 12：'}

{'original': "I'm looking forward to seeing what Apple brings next. They seem to have hit a peak with the rounded design language, so maybe we'll see a brand new shape. Hopefully it won't affect backward compatibility with older bands.", 'translation': '我對 Apple 接落嚟會帶嚟咩新嘢相當期待。佢哋似乎已經去到圓潤設計風格嘅頂峰，所以話唔定我哋會見到一個全新嘅外形。希望唔會影響對舊款錶帶嘅向後兼容性。'}

{'original': 'My favorite Apple accessory picks:', 'translation': '我最喜愛嘅 Apple 配件推介：'}

  • {'original': 'Anker Ultra-Slim MagSafe power bank', 'translation': 'Anker Ultra-Slim MagSafe 充電池'}
  • {'original': 'AirPods Pro 3 (twice the active noise cancellation of the AirPods Pro 2!)', 'translation': 'AirPods Pro 3（主動降噪效果比 AirPods Pro 2 提升兩倍！）'}
  • {'original': 'Anker Nano 45W fast charger (with smart display)', 'translation': 'Anker Nano 45W 快速充電器（配備智能顯示屏）'}
  • {'original': 'Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W slim MagSafe charger', 'translation': 'Anker Prime 3 合 1 25W 輕巧 MagSafe 充電器'}
  • {'original': 'Logitech MX Master 4 Mac mouse', 'translation': 'Logitech MX Master 4 專用 Mac 滑鼠'}
  • {'original': 'AirTag 2 four-pack (50% better location accuracy!)', 'translation': 'AirTag 2 四件裝（定位精準度提升 50%！）'}
  • {'original': 'Belkin 3-in-1 MagSafe iPhone charging stand', 'translation': 'Belkin 3 合 1 MagSafe iPhone 充電座'}

{'original': 'Follow Michael: X/Twitter, Bluesky, Instagram', 'translation': '追蹤 Michael：X/Twitter、Bluesky、Instagram'}
